meta.title: Skills & MCP
meta.description: Manage skills and MCP servers from Settings.

en.copyToOther: Copy to the other patch layer
en.deleteWarn: Removes the whole skill directory under DSH_HOME/skills. This cannot be undone.
en.formatJsonHint: Equivalent mcpServers JSON (paste-ready for other tools):
en.formatPaste: Paste a JSON config (mcpServers wrapper or a bare entry)
en.formatYamlHint: The complete row as it will land in the profile patch (live preview):
en.globalLayerError: Failed to read the global layer (DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml); global servers are hidden:
en.importCreateHint: New skills are written to the user directory; switch back to “Global” to create one, or use “Import skills” for a workspace.
en.importIntro: Scans the MCP server configs of Claude Code (~/.claude.json), Codex (~/.codex/config.toml), Cursor (~/.cursor/mcp.json), and Gemini CLI (~/.gemini/settings.json); selected entries land in the scope picked below.
en.marketEmpty: Market list is empty or unavailable
en.marketIntro: Curated skill repositories and MCP servers, installable with one click. The list comes from the plugin repository’s online index, falling back to the bundled snapshot offline.
en.marketMcpIntro: Adds MCP server rows (pick the target layer — this profile or global — above; restart to apply). Servers needing keys get their environment filled in on the row after install.
en.marketOffline: Online index unreachable — showing the bundled snapshot, which may lag behind.
en.marketRepoInstalled: Repository installed — its skills appear on the Skills tab shortly.
en.marketSkillsIntro: Installs skill repositories (GitHub download, live catalog); manage installed ones on the Skills tab.
en.marketUninstallRootWarn: Stops scanning the repository and deletes the downloaded copy (you can reinstall later).
en.mcpIntro: Manage MCP server rows (@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client). A server lives either in this profile or in the global layer (DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml, applied to every profile on this machine); additions, edits, and removals take effect after a dsh restart.
en.pasteTransportMismatch: This row’s transport is locked and differs from the pasted config.
en.removeRootWarn: Stops scanning the repository and deletes the copy downloaded into DSH_HOME (a local folder itself is untouched).
en.removeWarn: Removes the row from its configuration; its tools disappear after the next dsh restart.
en.restartConfirmBody: Restarting interrupts any running turn and may lose unsaved input; pending MCP changes apply after the restart.
en.restartDesktopHint: The desktop app owns restarts: use the tray “Restart service”.
en.restarting: Restarting — the page will reload once the host is back…
en.restartNeeded: Configuration written — restart dsh to apply.
en.restartOtherHint: Restart by closing this dsh process and running it again.
en.restartPortHint: If the page does not recover, the port may have changed: check the terminal for the new URL.
en.rootAdded: Repository added — the catalog follows live.
en.rootGitHint: Accepts https://github.com/owner/repo and owner/repo; pick a version with #branch or /tree/branch.
en.rootLocalHint: Point at one skill folder (with SKILL.md) or a folder of skill folders.
en.rootsIntro: Add skill repositories by hand: local folders are scanned in place (zero-copy), GitHub repos arrive as a downloaded copy inside DSH_HOME (no git needed). The Market tab offers curated repos with one click.
en.saved: Saved. The skills directory is watched; the skill is usable in sessions shortly.
en.scopeHint: Global writes DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml and applies to every profile on this machine; this profile writes the current profile only.
en.shadowedByGlobal: a global row with the same id wins — this row has no effect
en.skillDisabledMsg: Disabled: neither the model nor / commands will load it.
en.skillEnabled: Enabled — the list reflects it shortly.
en.skillImportIntro: Import skills from a folder, a single .md file, or a ZIP archive; a folder may be one skill directory or a collection of skill folders.
en.skillsIntro: View and edit the skills dsh discovers; user-level skills (DSH_HOME/skills) can be created, edited, and deleted here, and skills installed from market/local repositories edit in place too (their other frontmatter keys survive the write). Skill directories of local agents — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, and more, including nested installs — are scanned automatically (zero-copy, live-synced); the workspace picker scopes the view to a project’s .dsh/skills and .agents/skills. The switch on each card toggles loading: disabling removes the skill from both the model and user catalogs; enabling restores the default policy.
en.toggleSkillHint: Disabling writes disable-model-invocation and user-invocable into the skill’s SKILL.md, removing it from both catalogs; enabling restores the default policy. The rest of the file is untouched.
en.zipTooLarge: The ZIP exceeds the 32 MiB limit
